verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot docs confirm individual subscribers can opt out of AI model training data use at any time, giving some control over data usage, but there is no documented self-service mechanism for deleting stored chat/history data or explicit retention period controls. Community commentary also raises unresolved skepticism about enterprise assurances that code won't be used for training. Missing for 10: explicit data-deletion tooling, documented retention windows, and enterprise-level deletion guarantees beyond opt-out.
